scope: All child commands recorded in commands.json completed with their expected exit codes. The recorder then rejected the PowerShell file byte difference; no formal target was started.
cause: .gitattributes declares *.ps1 text eol=crlf. Git archive applies that rule; the working file had LF. The old recorder incorrectly required the actual byte SHA-256 to be identical.
fix: Reuse the unchanged autotuner.session.source_identity validator. Bind selected files to the content commit's Git blobs, record working and archive actual hashes separately, and allow only verified CRLF-to-LF conversion. Original teacher files remain strictly byte-identical.
